summary: Stop automatic optional Performance and Nix PR runs to reduce CI queue demand; retain main Performance, scheduled and manual runs, and Nix tag builds.

compatibility.detail: Required Workspace CI tests and deterministic cost checks are unchanged. Existing queued runs retain their original workflow; no cancellation or rerun is included.

manual.detail: Restoring PR triggers needs source review and a capacity decision; optional jobs remain available by manual dispatch.

recovery.detail: Revert this workflow change to restore automatic PR triggers.
